title: Bluest Account exclusive benefits
summary: This document lists Bluest Account exclusive benefits: 2.25% APY on checking, 10 complimentary domestic outgoing wires/month, $0.00 incoming domestic wire fee, up to $50/month ATM fee rebates, 3 free personal check orders/year, 75.0% safe deposit box discount, and $0 stop payment fee and $0 foreign ATM withdrawal fee. It also covers linked savings APY boosts (+0.45% Silver, +0.7% Bronze) and Bluest referral rewards ($75 referrer, $50 new member) with limits and eligibility (8 per calendar year; referred deposits $2,000 within 90 days; referrer Rho-Bank checking at least 60 days).
